title: Origins: Tortugan
description: Origin datapack that adds the Tortugan, an origin based on the Turtle.
body:
Origin datapack that adds the Tortugan, an origin based on the Turtle.

Making great use of their strong outer shell, the Tortugans are experts of defense.

![Tortugan Power List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a9729db59314e0b8205ab5a1f30d4c934e41cd08.png)
